name: Physics article (REVTeX / arXiv quant-ph)
description: A standard long-form physics paper: introduction, preliminaries, methods, results, discussion and outlook, with appendices.

sections.title: Title, authors, affiliations
sections.purpose: Who did the work and where.

sections.title: Abstract
sections.purpose: One paragraph: problem, approach, main result. No citations; define acronyms.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.purpose: Context, the gap, your contribution, and a roadmap of the paper.

sections.title: Background / Preliminaries
sections.purpose: Notation, definitions and prior results you build on.

sections.title: Methods / Model / Setup
sections.purpose: What you did, in enough detail to reproduce it.

sections.title: Discussion
sections.purpose: What the results mean, their limitations, and comparison with prior work.

sections.title: Data / Code availability
sections.purpose: Where the data and code behind the results can be found.

sections.title: Appendices
sections.purpose: Proofs, derivations and extra data that would interrupt the main text.

abstract.note: Lemma's default target (a style choice). Check your journal's own limit.
